correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of exact Eq.(6) gives Phi-dot=z²-(1+b)y² and E={y=z=0}. For b≤-1, the nonnegative integral vanishes on an interval only if z=0 and then y constant; if y !=0, zdot=wy=0 forces w=0 but wdot=-y²<0, contradiction. Strict Φ increase excludes recurrence and, on compact forward/both-sided orbits, LaSalle restricts limit sets to E; bounded x ensures w−Phi=bxy→0. Compact invariant probability stationarity gives E[z²]=(1+b)E[y²], and b=-1 support invariance plus bounded x forces y=0. A periodic orbit has zero-mean y and integral z²=(1+b)y², hence Wirtinger T≥2pi/sqrt(1+b); equality y sinusoidal incompatible with zdot=w(y-a z) for a!=0 or wdot at extremum for a=0. Independent SymPy coboundary/parameter identity checks passed.
